dataset: Generated analysis cohort, 2000 synthetic students, matches the P6-C database schema (attendance, assessment, enrollment). Not the Kaggle Students Performance dataset.
target: completion_risk = 1 if the student ends the course without a certificate
excluded_protected_or_sensitive: None collected: the schema has no gender, age, religion, disability, ethnicity, income or health field for students.
known_limitations: Trained on synthetic data generated to match this project's schema, not on real trainees.
The logistic regression does not clearly beat the rule baseline on F1 or accuracy here; only ROC-AUC is higher.
Positive class is about 51% of the generated cohort, higher than a real cohort is likely to be; recall/precision will differ on real data.
fallback: If this file is missing or fails to load, use the deterministic rule (rule_score >= 2 = Medium risk, >= 4 = High) computed directly from attendance, missed assessments, pending sign-offs and non-pass results. Same inputs, no model required.
explanation_shown_to_user: List the rule conditions that fired (e.g. 'Attendance 58% is below 60%', '2 assessments still unsigned'), regardless of whether the rule or the model produced the flag.
